annotations.text:
This one is live — try it.

Drag the card sideways, or use
← → to decide, E to edit the art,
U to undo.

The art shown is real: three entries
lifted from use_for_gags.txt with
overlay lines composed under them,
which is exactly what ADR-0104
ships.

The 40-column readout is live off
the textarea, and it FLAGS rather
than cuts — a line that runs long
is the operator's call, not the
page's.

The drawing itself can now only be
wrong because a human made it
wrong; the model can no longer
touch it.

Swipe left files an `art` report
against the card, which is the
reason type /admin/repairs already
has. So this page adds a queue,
not a second repair system.
